screens: control panel (New Game: Easy, Normal, Hard)
F3: the keycaps, the cursor on Jumping
Alt: That Key is Already Used!
Enter on Jumping a third time
Right: the cursor to the next keycap
note: SCR-01D (Keen Dreams v1.00): the control panel's options: C opens Choose Controls (keyboard; the joysticks are not there, disabled), F3 the keycaps; Enter on Jumping blinks it, Z sets it, Alt is refused (That Key is Already Used!), Ctrl puts it back; Right moves the cursor; F2 the sound devices (PC Speaker, off, AdLib by number), F7 music (off, AdLib); Escape closes the panel (v1.00's Loading box) to the title.
